deadline.value: Official deadline February 1, 2027 for September 2027 entry; apply by December 1, 2026 for full entrance-scholarship consideration (rolling review Dec 1 - Feb 1).
deadline.quote: U.S. and International Applicants | The official University of Alberta deadline is February 1 for September admission. | For full consideration for entrance scholarships and invitation to our visitation weekend (Canadian/U.S. applicants), please apply by December 1.

gre_general.value: Chemistry does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The department does not require applicants to submit a GRE test score.

gre_subject.value: No GRE score (General or Chemistry) is required.
gre_subject.quote: The department does not require applicants to submit a GRE test score.

supervisor.value: No supervisor needed to apply; students choose a group after arriving, though contacting faculty is recommended.
supervisor.quote: You do not have to find a supervisor in order to apply. The Department has a process in place for students to find a supervisor and join a research group once they arrive to start their program.

funding.value: PhD students are guaranteed 5 years of funding (TA/RA/scholarship); full TA stipend about CAD 29,250 a year.
funding.quote: PhD students are guaranteed funding for 5 years total. | The minimum annual stipend, based on a full-time teaching assistantship is approximately $29,250.

entry_route.value: You can apply to the PhD directly with a BSc, or with a master's.
entry_route.quote: No. Students who have completed a BSc (or equivalent) can apply to either the MSc or PhD program.

notes: CV not required. Application fee reimbursed on arrival if admitted.
